name: weather-app
description: Full-stack weather app with real-time weather search, JWT authentication, and a Node.js/Express backend deployed on Render with Neon PostgreSQL.

paragraphs: A full-stack weather application that allows users to search for the current weather of cities around the world through a web interface connected to a real-time Backend API, with built-in user registration and login functionality.

This project is part of my DevOps and Cloud Engineering learning journey. It focuses on connecting a Frontend and Backend deployed separately on different Cloud Platforms, implementing End-to-End Authentication, and migrating the Backend between Cloud Platforms without affecting users.
features: Frontend deployed on Vercel with two pages: Weather Search and Login/Register
Backend API deployed on Render using a separate domain
Database using PostgreSQL hosted on Neon
External API using WeatherAPI.com to retrieve real-world weather data
Solving CORS issues when the Frontend and Backend are hosted on different domains
